nota: Prova da caça de bandeiras: o registro que a API do Commons devolveu para cada arquivo (imageinfo + extmetadata + wikitext da página), lido com o User-Agent do canal (canal.json > contato). O sha1 de cada arquivo baixado foi conferido com o sha1 da API; o sha256 é o do arquivo em out/juneau/_media/logo/. As listagens de categoria vieram do scripts/stock/_commons-cat.mjs (REGIE_MOTOR=C:/projetos/regie-v1). Os arquivos de reserva ficaram só em out/juneau/_tmp/logos/ (fora do git), não foram entregues.

pedido_de_apagamento_bc.wikitext: {{delh}} === [[:File:Flag of British Columbia.svg]] === This file was initially tagged by [[User:70.68.168.129|70.68.168.129]] as '''Copyvio''' (Copyvio) and the most recent rationale was: Per https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/governments/celebrating-british-columbia/symbols-of-bc#flag, this flag is protected via Crown copyright.. Perhaps, but [https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/british-columbians-our-governments/celebrating-british-columbia/symbols-of-bc/bc-emblems-set.pdf the source] gives the flag's publication date as 1960, and [[COM:CANADA]] indicates that crown copyright lasts only 50 years post-publication (i.e. 2010). This may cause potential URAA issues, but that's a DR issue rather than a speedy deletion issue. — [[User:Red-tailed hawk|Red-tailed hawk]] [[User talk:Red-tailed hawk|(nest)]] 17:42, 16 July 2023 (UTC) :I'm also going to note that [https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File%3AFlag_of_British_Columbia.svg&diff=prev&oldid=131009127 source information] has been radically changed over time; there may well be a past version of this that is re-created only by looking at the statutory text description of the flag, which would be perfectly acceptable. — [[User:Red-tailed hawk|Red-tailed hawk]] [[User talk:Red-tailed hawk|(nest)]] 17:48, 16 July 2023 (UTC) :Also note [https://web.archive.org/web/20140725090141/https://www2.gov.bc.ca/bcfacts/ this government website], which say {{tq|The Provincial flag is public domain and not protected by the Provincial Symbols and Honours Act}}. — [[User:Red-tailed hawk|Red-tailed hawk]] [[User talk:Red-tailed hawk|(nest)]] 17:54, 16 July 2023 (UTC) :*{{vk}} That sounds conclusive. -- [[User:Ikan Kekek|Ikan Kekek]] ([[User talk:Ikan Kekek|{{int:Talkpagelinktext}}]]) 20:47, 16 July 2023 (UTC) ---- '''Kept:''' no valid reason for deletion. —'''[[User:Holly Cheng|holly]]''' {[[User talk:Holly Cheng|chat]]} 01:50, 11 November 2023 (UTC) {{delf}}
